mask.kernel_note: 4 px closing leaves 5 components; 5 px is the smallest tested kernel that restores one connected design network

network.class_counts_note: road class is assigned by brown/blue pixel majority along each centerline; colour is not a topology separator

separate_colour_baseline.note: separate brown/blue skeletons cut the design network at colour boundaries and produced nine artificial components

rejected_connectors.note: nearest-node straight-line connectors are not road connectivity and are not used

method: union brown+blue road mask -> component filter -> 5 px closing -> thinning -> pixel graph -> junction clustering -> spur pruning -> degree-2 contraction -> colour class assignment
rules: road connectivity is derived from the unified road mask
colour is a road-class attribute, not a topology separator
the closing kernel and component filtering are recorded
junctions are skeleton graph nodes, not inferred connectors
rejected nearest-node connectors are retained as negative evidence
no width, cross-section, alignment or surface is inferred
non_claims: junction candidates are proposed and need review
road class is inferred from sketch colour, not confirmed
no road width, cross-section, profile, alignment or surface
image-space topology only; no project coordinates or metric lengths
blue combines 支路 and 入户路; subtypes are not separated
